# Historical DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 candidate lock

[简体中文](README.md) | **English**

This directory preserves the candidate inputs and checks for DSH `0.1.7-rc.1`, pinned to upstream commit `46a7f68b0922371ce7144b668b90e377d8e799f4`. `LOCK.json` records the source, npm Runtime, and dependency integrity. This candidate is outside the current desktop release recipe.

Use [`config/desktop-build.json`](../../../config/desktop-build.json) and the [DSH 0.2.0 integration guide](../../../docs/CORE-020_EN.md) for the current pinned source build and qualification. Host, plugin, and desktop adapter commands for this old candidate are no longer maintained; do not pair the current scripts with this lock.
